shellCommands.command: cat node_modules/next/package.json | head -40 && echo "---CACHE DTS---" && cat node_modules/next/cache.d.ts 2>/dev/null
grep -rn "refresh" node_modules/next/AGENTS.md | head -40; echo "=== docs ==="; ls node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/ | head
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "=== BUILD ==="; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40

ls -R /workspace/app; (npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o 'Notifications are <strong>[a-z]*'; echo "--- form fields ---"; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o '\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]*'

cd /tmp && curl -s -i -X POST localhost:3111/ -H 'Origin: http://localhost:3111' -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' --data '$ACTION_ID_009e6253f49a4b08f6d831dde56852f15e4e385127=' | head -12; echo "=== body state after POST ==="; curl -s -X POST localhost:3111/ -H 'Origin: http://localhost:3111' -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' --data '$ACTION_ID_009e6253f49a4b08f6d831dde56852f15e4e385127=' | grep -o 'Notifications are <strong>[a-z]*'
curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o 'Notifications are <strong>[a-z]*'; echo "=== log ==="; cat /tmp/next.log

curl -s -X POST localhost:3111/ -H 'Origin: http://localhost:3111' -F '$ACTION_ID_009e6253f49a4b08f6d831dde56852f15e4e385127=' | grep -o 'Notifications are <strong>[a-z]*'; echo "=== GET after ==="; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o 'Notifications are <strong>[a-z]*'

curl -s -D /tmp/h.txt -o /tmp/b.html -X POST localhost:3111/ -H 'Origin: http://localhost:3111' -F '$ACTION_ID_009e6253f49a4b08f6d831dde56852f15e4e385127='; head -1 /tmp/h.txt; grep -ci location /tmp/h.txt; grep -o 'Notifications are <strong>[a-z]*' /tmp/b.html; pkill -f "next start" ; echo stopped
